purpose: The Plan record types and what each one shows: the type names, the Development Resource and Value-card gates, each type's line order, its default level and the words of its lines.
namedChanges: Comments made generic (a person's name and the names of internal tools removed from four doc comments).

the one import, `import { typeFacetKey } from "./workingSetFacets"`, is now `import { typeKey as typeFacetKey } from "@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-type-key"`, so every call site is as in the source. The source's `typeFacetKey` asks the app's type registry first; the `type-key` default answers as if the registry knew no type, and a host with a registry calls `setTypeKey`.

library.title: Plan card types and their lines
library.note: Which lines each Plan type shows, in order; the drawn card is plan-card. Plan.Type
